Map an index-type data source to its internal-OSA field names

index_osa_field_map.Rd

Translates an index-type data source identifier into the exact field names used in the model data list, following the naming convention used throughout SPoRC_rtmb.R (e.g. ObsFishIdx, UseFishIdx).

Usage

index_osa_field_map(index_source, pop = FALSE)

Arguments

index_source

One of "Catch", "Discard", "FishIdx", "SrvIdx".

pop

Logical; population-specific index source.

Value

A named list of field names: Obs, Use.
